dish_name: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Walnuts
instructions: Put the 3/4 cup walnuts in a dry skillet over medium. Toast them for 3 to 4 minutes, shaking the pan often, until they're a shade darker and smell toasty. Watch them near the end. They burn fast.
Tip the walnuts into a small bowl and break up any big pieces with your fingers. Pour in the 1/3 cup honey and stir until every piece is coated.
Stir the 1/2 tsp vanilla into the 3 cups yogurt until smooth, then divide it among 4 bowls.
Spoon the honey walnuts over each bowl and dust the tops with the 1/4 tsp cinnamon.
Serve right away. If it sits, the honey turns the yogurt runny.
method_notes: All three top thick, plain Greek yogurt with honey and walnuts. My Greek Dish toasts the walnuts first, tosses them in honey while they're warm, stirs a little vanilla into the yogurt and finishes with cinnamon. Real Greek Recipes layers yogurt, honey and raw walnuts in a jar, and Walnuts.org spoons toasted nuts and a small drizzle of honey over plain or vanilla yogurt with optional fruit or granola. This one follows My Greek Dish, toasting the nuts in a dry pan instead of the oven to keep it quick.
